Wolf"Ah, Cannon, my friend. Well?"
Wolf"You kept hold of hope, I trust?"

Cannon"Comrade?"
Wolf"Him."

en.html:
Cannon"...Professor. Is he not Yamato?"
Wolf"Yes. Yamato, and my friend. Surely neither fact requires attention just now?"
Wolf"Come, Lieutenant Colonel. Resume."
Cannon"What?"
Wolf"Do not sleep through the answer. Our contest, naturally."
Cannon"...At this stage? Everything is over."
Cannon"Presently I am a traitor awaiting execution. Escape makes me, at best, a fugitive awaiting arrest."
Wolf"A sorry statement. Did Major General Willow not entrust his dream to you?"
Cannon"..."
Wolf"Publicly, you are not yet a traitor."
Cannon"...What?"
Wolf"Ruby Sarchant has not grasped the whole separatist presence inside GHQ. He fears announcing the incident might send them out of control."
Wolf"Correct, Bartolomeo?"
常闇斎"Yes."
Cannon"..."
Wolf"You understand, Lieutenant Colonel."
Wolf"Remove Count Sarchant, and even now the position can be recovered!"
Cannon"..."
